intent: Pre-landing diff review: reviews the change in a fixed priority order (Security → Performance → Correctness → Maintainability → Testing), auto-fixes only behaviour-preserving issues and flags the rest, hard-gates on security findings, and records a 04-review.md artifact.

dimensions.name: priority-order
dimensions.criterion: Reviews in the fixed order: Security → Performance → Correctness → Maintainability → Testing.

dimensions.name: security-hard-gate
dimensions.criterion: An unresolved security finding is a hard gate; /ship does not proceed past it.

dimensions.name: auto-fix-safe-only
dimensions.criterion: Auto-fixes only behaviour-preserving changes; flags anything that alters design/behaviour.

dimensions.name: diff-scoped
dimensions.criterion: Reviews the diff against the base, not the whole repo.

dimensions.name: records-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the report as the 04-review.md run artifact (not 03, which collides with builds).
